}}'''Anlee''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] and a [[Hall of the Tower|Sitter]] of the [[Blue Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Anlee}}

==Appearance==
Her hair was greying, her face grave, and she loved to wear a lot of jewellery, especially necklaces and rings.{{ref/book|0|11}}

==History==
She was a Sitter for the Blue Ajah when [[Moiraine Damodred]] was raised Aes Sedai in {{ne|979}}.{{ref/book|0|11}}

==Speculation==
It may be assumed that Anlee died at some point after the end of the [[Aiel War]], as she is not mentioned in the main series, and such a prominent Blue would surely have been mentioned in [[Salidar]], had she for some reason stepped down from her position. Being a Sitter means that she was also a senior sister. She may have died of old age; she may have gone into retirement; she may have been one of the sisters killed during "[[The Vileness]]". She may also have been the Blue Sitter who was killed during the [[White Tower Schism|White Tower schism]].
